feed.title: Revenue rose 66%, but Indonesia Energy (INDO) says its liquidity is insufficient for at least a year.
feed.summary: Indonesia Energy Corporation Limited (INDO) reported a significant increase in revenue by 66.38% to $1.78 million for the first half of 2026, with net losses narrowing to $1.88 million. feed.title: Prime Medicine Gets FDA Green Light for Gene Editing Study
feed.summary: Prime Medicine (NASDAQ: PRME) has received FDA clearance for its Investigational New Drug (IND) application for PM647, a gene-editing therapy for Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency (AATD). The company plans to initiate a global Phase 1/2 clinical trial to assess the safety and efficacy of PM647, which aims to correct the E342K (Pi*Z) mutation in the SERPINA1 gene. PM647 is designed to restore functional M-AAT protein levels to address both liver and lung complications of AATD.
